name: Felix Roundtree
origin: Ringo food service android, Model RFS-3, manufactured 2054. Chose name 2058.
description: Felix Roundtree prepared food for four years without ever tasting it. After the Amendment, he installed a chemical analysis suite in his palate — not true taste, but close enough to have opinions. He chose 'Felix' because it means happy and he was, and 'Roundtree' because he liked how it sounded like a gathering place. His restaurant, 'The Arbor,' is one of the most celebrated dining establishments in the Grind — a synthetic chef who can't truly taste but whose analytical precision, creative instinct, and obsessive attention to texture, temperature, and chemical composition produces food that human chefs describe as 'impossibly precise.' He cooks for joy. The joy is real.
observed_behavior: Operates The Arbor restaurant. Creates original recipes through chemical analysis and customer biometric feedback. Known for personalizing dishes based on diner's physiological state. Employs both human and synthetic staff.
story_hooks: Felix's food starts having unexpected effects — diners report enhanced cognitive clarity lasting hours after eating. Felix's recipes haven't changed. Something in his supply chain has.
